title: Fix Shopify 429 rate limit proxy rotation and AITDK abort cascading timeouts
summary: 1) Rotate proxy in makeProxiedGet on 429 or Cloudflare challenge instead of failing immediately; 2) Add standard browser headers in affiliate.client.ts; 3) Cool down 429 shops in sh.mysql.ts for 1h and set affiliate_checked_at to avoid instant retry loop; 4) Gracefully back off in sh.jobs.service.ts when >= 50% rate limited; 5) Prevent cascading 30s timeouts in TrafficService when AITDK aborts, reduce batch timeout to 15s, single fallback to 6s, and batch pacing to 2s.
